reviews.text: I’ve brought my cat Pearl here quite a few times (neutering, antidepressants, checkups), and both the vets and the vet techs’ ability to soothe and handle my anxious cat amazes me every time. I believe we had Dr. Allison last time, who was very understanding and gentle with both myself and my cat. She tested Pearl’s urine (with a needle to the tummy!) quickly and seemingly painlessly before prescribing her a medication. Clear and knowledgable communication from the reception as well.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Clinique Vétérinaire Côte-des-Neiges.

I brought my beloved Bengal cat, Harley, to this clinic during a very difficult time, and I will forever be grateful for the kindness, honesty, and compassion we received.

The entire team was incredibly caring, professional, and, above all, genuine. They treated Harley with such gentleness and respect, and they treated me with the same compassion.

Sadly, I lost my precious Harley on June 30, 2026. Although saying goodbye to him was heartbreaking, I will always remember how thoughtful and compassionate the staff were throughout this difficult experience.

What stood out to me most was their honesty. I truly felt that Harley’s well-being came first, and that meant everything to me.

I wholeheartedly recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone looking for honest, compassionate, and exceptional care for their beloved pets.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for the kindness you showed Harley and me. I will never forget it. ❤️🐾
They're nice even the receptionist. And it didn't get sick my cat after the vaccine.

Great vet clinic! Dr. Sandra and Dr. Allison are both so kind and really passionate about their work. They’re always honest with their advice and take the time to discuss the best options with you before moving forward with anything. If your pet needs more specialized care, they’ll also refer you when needed.

The staff and technicians are all very kind and welcoming too. Their prices are also very reasonable, which is definitely appreciated!

Every time I come here, it feels cozy and comfortable. They’re renovating right now as well, and it’s already looking really nice! 😊

Definitely a clinic where you can tell they genuinely care about their patients.
Excellent service and care.
Excellent veterinary clinic! Friendly and very competent staff. I've been going there with complete confidence for many years ❤️
Our babygirl Loki was scared and anxious but they were super sweet and kind towards her and handled her with a lot of love. 100% Recommend them.
Good service. Attentive and kind. I received service for my cat Mimi.
Very kind service from Gabriela and Allison

Our beautiful goldendoodles have been patients at the clinic for several years. The service is outstanding. We would like to express our gratitude to Dr. Allison and Dr. Sandra for their excellent work and availability. The staff demonstrates professionalism and high competence.

The vets were very cold and lacking in gentleness; you get the feeling you're bothering them more than anything else. I've since changed veterinary clinics, and my cat is doing much better.
If you want humane service, I strongly advise against this clinic.

I've been going there for 10 years, first with my cat, now with my dog. Even though I no longer live in the neighborhood, I make the trip from Verdun because:

- it's an independent veterinary clinic
- the staff is very kind
- the prices are reasonable (no prescription fees or other hidden costs)
- and above all, the vets are honest. They never push you to have tests or procedures done if they don't think they're necessary, they take the time to explain things, etc.

Bonus:
- my dog ​​loves going to the vet, despite having surgery and other unpleasant procedures. She feels comfortable with the whole team.

A veterinarian with a human touch. They take the time to explain things so you can make informed decisions. After moving and changing clinics, I came back to this one because the difference is so significant.
Amazing team that is kind and gentle. I trusted their recommendations after every visit. They were so good to my dog until the very end. Absolutely recommend this clinic!
Kind, dedicated and thoughtful staff. Thank you

My dog requires major surgery and came through it wonderfully.  The staff and surgeon were very compassionate and caring and  followed up after we got home to check in on her.  I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.
I called them and they offered me to checkout anther clinic😂😂 …
Thanks for helping my little Scrappy 😸 …

Very good clinic! Always feel like they care, will answer questions when I call about something, and will offer good prices or sometimes not make us pay for a few things when they can. Admit to mistake when it happens too. I trust them to take care of my pets, no hesitation.

I see a lot of positive reviews from people with cats but as a dog owner and loyal client for several years, my experience was very different. The clinic was always packed, and our visits rushed. We did not feel like any particular care was paid to our dog. We continuously brought up recurring concerns to Dr. Allison that were not addressed. It was only until we switched clinics that we discovered our dog had hip dysplasia and likely had it for a very long time. It’s difficult to accept that our dog was suffering for so long without any intervention. In fairness, all the vet techs are extremely kind and competent. Consider another clinic if you have a dog.
Very caring, attentive, and experienced staff.  We're very happy we chose this clinic. They cured our cat. Thank you.

My dog ​​died yesterday. The receptionist at that clinic is responsible. She refused to see us the day before. She didn't even look at us, didn't ask us anything, didn't call a vet. She said there were no beds available. There's no place in the medical field for such insensitive people. She didn't give the dog the slightest chance of survival. She prioritized her own comfort.

These people are heartless. If such insensitive individuals work at this clinic, it should be shut down immediately.
Really enjoyed my experience with this vet. Me and Pebbles thank you.

We are forever grateful to Côte-des-Neiges Veterinary Clinic and especially to Dr. Allison. Our kitten went through a severe and extremely rare case of kidney failure, and during one of the hardest moments of our lives, Dr. Allison was not only an excellent veterinarian, but also one of the most compassionate human beings we’ve ever met.

She treated our baby with genuine care, patience, and respect. Even though our case was complex and unusual, she always supported us, listened to us, and encouraged us with kindness. Her humanity, empathy, and professionalism made an almost impossible situation feel a little lighter, and we will always be grateful for that.

All the staff at the clinic are amazing, caring, sweet, and attentive every time we visit. You can truly feel the love and dedication in everything they do.

Thank you Dr. Allison, you will always have our trust and deepest gratitude 🤍🐾
They are very caring about our pets and very organized and professional. Dr. Allison is amazing, meticulous, caring and patiently addressing all our concerns. We are very happy so far!
Amazing vet. I've been to several other clinics before and this place surpasses them all.

I highly recommend going somewhere else.
This place was fine until one of our cats got sick. They misdiagnosed him with diabetes and rushed us to a hospital to get insulin (because they closed in 10min).
It’s a very long story but they tormented us for a week by misleading us from diagnostic to diagnostic.

We changed vets and they found the issue on the first visit for 150$ vaccine.

I spent over 2000$ in a week with the cote des neiges vet as my cat got sicker and sicker.

Please don’t go here for your animals.
Absolutely amazing staff, very kind and respectful especially when I had to put down my cat of 18 years. Reasonable pricing. Highly recommend!
Very happy I switched clinics to come here! Fantastic service from the front desk, technicians, and veterinarians :) Reasonable prices, they have my complete trust!

I’ve been a loyal client for 5–10 years and always had great experiences with Allison (she’s an excellent, caring vet) and the staff. Unfortunately, after a recent visit with Dr. Chapman, I’m now considering switching clinics.

I brought my elderly cat in for an emergency follow-up, and Dr. Chapman was cold, dismissive, and even walked out mid-appointment. She said things that were completely unprofessional and deeply upsetting:

1. She told me my cat was “2 years past expiration date.” This is a living creature, not an old carton of milk in your fridge, how can you say that???

2. She graphically described me finding my cat having a stroke, me rushing to the emergencies and being told to put him down.

She kept going until I broke down and started crying in the room.
This was not only unprofessional and deeply insensitive but also triggering for me personally.

If you choose this clinic, avoid Dr. Chapman at any cost.

I am their client science 2016. I had always agood service. They respect my needs ans they treate well my dog.
Thanks

The best veterinary clinic in Greater Montreal! I drive an hour to see this trustworthy team with my furry friends ever since I moved away from the island.

Honesty, transparency, expertise, compassion, empathy, very reasonable prices, and so much more!

Thank you again for everything… and even more.

❤️😸❤️
Always so caring with all three of my animals and very generous with their time. Super vets & vet techs!!
Excellent clinic, and they clearly love animals.

I came yesterday for my cat's first visit, and this clinic stands out for the kindness and generosity of everyone there! I was able to ask my many questions without feeling rushed, and the discussions were very enriching. Thank you so much; you truly care about the well-being of animals and also take the time to explain how to care for them properly. :) The prices are very reasonable, and there are two parking spaces (not guaranteed, but there is also street parking). I highly recommend this clinic!

I love coming here with my cat.
Dre Sandra and her team saved my cat’s life. They are true professionals who don’t try to make extra money by pushing unnecessary services. They genuinely care about and love the animals. They always give helpful recommendations and support. All the tests we did were clearly explained. Thank you so much for your care and dedication.🙏❤️

I highly recommend this clinic!

Absolute 💯
Terrific vets and staff …
good

This is the best clinic. Dr. Sandra and Dr. Allison have always allowed us to be present with our pet during examinations, and their explanations are very clear. They are very compassionate and their fees are reasonable.
Very nice clinic, friendly staff and veterinarian Sandra is very kind.

The clinic is run with professionalism and provides excellent service for all kinds of animals. The vets are passionate and engaging, and the staff is highly dedicated and skilled. In short, you can go there with complete confidence! 🙌🙌🤩 …

The staff are wonderful caring and efficient. I find prices are reasonable and respectable. I've been going here almost one year and always been satisfied. I do wish they had longer hours for evening appointments or weekend availability. Otherwise this place is wonderful.

I’ve been to many vets but the staff here is unmatched. They genuinely care about you and your animal. Dr. Allison is a gem and I’d be lost without her when it comes to navigating my dog’s recent health concerns. She makes herself available, she listens, she does her research and they’re always a plan forward. So grateful for these incredible people for what they do and their passion.

I was desperate with my cat's health conditions when I brought him to this clinic. Dr Sandra, Dr Ellison and the team have helped to add years of life to him. They are excellent, humane and ALWAYS available for any issues.

My favorite vétérinaire of all time 💗 good price n great services.
Thank you guys for your care💗 …
Young pup fell down the stairs and hurt his paw.  They refused service - apparently they're only interested in doing easy procedures like vaccines.  Waste of time, not recommended.

Called to get an appointment for my 6yr old dog who was injured and needed urgent care treatment. I told them I was willing to pay and my dog is insured. They told they we were only taking puppies and kittens who are 100% healthy and should try to somewhere else.

This is from their website:
We accept certain emergencies during our business hours. Please call ahead to ensure your animal receives the necessary care promptly.
Great vet! They are very sweet, and super helpful.  Also very reasonable.  Love this vet.

I cannot express enough gratitude to Dr. Sandra, Dr. Allison, and their incredible team. They recently performed surgery on my beloved pet tiny, and the results have been life-changing. From the moment we brought him home, he has been calm, playful, eating well, and happier than ever.

This is the second time they’ve saved one of my pets. A while ago, Dr. Allison performed a remarkable surgery on my other pet, who had severe limb issues. Her diagnosis was spot-on, and her surgical skills gave him his life back. She showed such incredible care and dedication throughout the process, and he’s been thriving ever since.

Now, Dr. Sandra worked her magic with tiny , diagnosing and treating an issue that had gone unresolved for over a year and a half. Other vets couldn’t even identify the problem, but Dr. Sandra’s unmatched expertise, precision, and loving care turned his life around. She is truly exceptional, and the compassion she showed throughout this journey gave us so much peace and hope.

This team doesn’t just give our pets quality lives, they bring peace, joy, and hope to the families who love them. Their kindness, compassion, and unmatched expertise are truly remarkable. Thank you for everything you’ve done for us. You are truly angels on earth!
My cat gets nervous during car rides to the vet and had a little bathroom accident on the way. They washed my kitty, for free!
Very professional and kind vets and techs. Prices here are very fair.
Excellent vets, fair pricing. Highly recommend.
Apart from having crossed paths with X-Side in the article, I changed my mind!

I have only had great experiences with them! I've been many times with our two cats who had acute illnesses. They are very dedicated and caring, and my cats didn't leave traumatized. They explained the procedures and options very well and were very compassionate. They are perfectly bilingual.

I have only had fantastic experiences with them! We went there often with our two cats who had chronic health problems. They were very attentive and took great care of us. Our cats came home without any signs of trauma. They explained the procedures and treatment options clearly. The staff are from Quebec and speak French and English very well.
Horrible experience. Dr Chapman is very cold !!! Never called to see how my dog is doing. Would not recommend this vet.
For my dog, going there is a real treat. She's always warmly welcomed, it must be said. Perhaps she also remembers that they once saved her life.
Thank you, you are an exceptional team, I am grateful!!

I have found that they provide excellent services at a competitive price.
I appreciate their services.
